summary:
What did we develop?
Our team developed CosmoMetrics: Space Weather and Survival, an interactive, video game-style simulator that immerses players in space exploration across three distinct environments: Earth’s Orbit, the Moon, and Mars.

Designed for junior astronauts and space enthusiasts, the simulator features two core game modes:

Educational Mode: Acts as an interactive guide that breaks down every in-game element, explaining its scientific purpose and how it contributes to mission success. It also answers common curiosities people have when watching real space footage—such as "What is that component, and what does it actually do?"

Experimental Mode: Challenges players to customize their mission name and location, stepping into the boots of an astronaut to survive in extreme space environments. Players must actively complete critical tasks and manage real-time hazards to protect both their equipment and the astronaut's health.
How does it address the challenge? 
The application addresses the challenge by leveraging the constant use of technology in daily life and the widespread use of mobile applications. Furthermore, the simulator has its own website, such as this one: 'https://CosmoMetrics.com', allowing enthusiasts to enjoy the experience from any country or region. This further prepares young people who dream of space exploration for their future careers.

Why is important?
Is important because democratizes space education to inspire future explorers.
details: What does it do & how does it work? It is an interactive web simulator (https://CosmoMetrics.com) set in Earth's orbit, the Moon, and Mars. It features an Educational Mode (explaining space gear, science, and mission roles) and an Experimental Mode (survival missions and real-time space weather risk management). Benefits & Impact: Democratizes global access to aerospace education without requiring expensive hardware, inspiring and preparing the next generation of STEM explorers. Tools & Technologies: Developed using accessible web technologies and conceptual prototyping focused on user experience. Creativity & Approach: Gamifies real space science and planetary survival across multiple environments, turning any device into a space training academy.
